verdict.rationale: An API-reference section exists, but the evidence shows only Docker run instructions there. Nothing documents an interactive explorer, try-it playground, or runnable request examples, and every OpenAPI/Swagger spec probe returned 404. The `cognee-cli demo` working example is a CLI feature, not an interactive API reference, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
